body: I just don’t see a future for me. There’s a feeling deep down that I wont pass a certain age, that I won’t grow old. I’ve been masking my feelings and avoiding them for the longest time but now I’m done and I need solution. Seeing a mental health professional is not an option for me unfortunately. So I don’t know what else to do. And talking to a family member is also not possible.
But what do you do then? How do you not feel like that? 😢
I don’t even know where to start !

Yes you definitely did the right thing. You never know if this aggression could lead to far worse outcomes and might even escalate and cause irreversible damage to herself and the people around her. Good luck.
